تصطبنوا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَبِنُوا (taṣṭabinū) /tasˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# تُصْطَبَنُوا (tuṣṭabanū) /tusˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
